Ask the organism

It answers in this tab first. The code below is the organism's own conversation region (a greeting, a question about the organism, thanks, a farewell), its exact reader and its word problem reader, the same files node bin/brain.mjs ask runs, copied byte for byte: no model, no server, no token, no request. A question the tab does not carry is posted once to the organism on the server (/api/ask), which answers it through the same ask() as the CLI; the tab's own refusal lines print under that answer, never guessed.
act/exact-read.mjs 6d7e524b90a6 tasks/exact.mjs ede0ce88f1ad act/word.mjs c2dd2fe71b77 act/converse.mjs 4389c43af457
ready. type a question, or pick one below.
brain ask dilation >
Every answer prints how it was reached: route (which path answered), provenance (native: the conversation region; exact: computed with BigInt rationals, never rounded; memory; model), model (none: no language model was called, or the provider and model the server called), and two clocks: a tab answer prints the nanoseconds per ask measured on YOUR device (median of 7 timed batches of the same ask); a server answer prints the microseconds ask() took on the server and the round trip this tab measured in milliseconds. The same question on the command line: node bin/brain.mjs ask dilation "hey" --provider null. The distance to the frontier is on the ladder, from the verdict files.
